descriptionAr: About the Team The HR Business Partner team at OpenAI supports managers and employees as teams grow, perform and adapt. We work alongside managers at all levels to resolve day-to-day people challenges, build management capability and create the conditions for teams to do their best work. Our expertise spans team effectiveness, talent development, manager coaching, employee relations and change management, grounded in our Contributions & Impact (C&I) culture. We operate with urgency, empathy and sound judgment, valuing sincerity, collaboration and meaningful impact. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior HR Business Partner to support managers and teams across EMEA, with a primary focus on Go-to-Market and responsibility for selected other functions in the region. You’ll provide hands-on support to managers at all levels, owning day-to-day people work and helping teams grow and scale effectively. Your GTM partnership will span teams such as Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships and Marketing. Across your portfolio, you’ll build a deep understanding of business priorities and use that context to prioritise and deliver practical people support. As a hands-on partner to managers at all levels, you will use independent judgment to coach managers, resolve people issues and follow through on day-to-day work as teams scale. You will own delivery across your portfolio, working closely with the International HRBP Leader, Recruiting, Finance, Employment Legal and People centres of expertise, and involving specialist partners when needed. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the International HRBP Leader. Your Key Responsibilities Own day-to-day HRBP support with a primary focus on GTM. Be a practical point of contact for managers on performance, employee relations, team changes and development. Prioritise issues, agree clear next steps and see them through to resolution as teams scale. Support teams as they grow. Help managers put agreed team structures and workforce plans into practice, clarify roles and address capacity needs as teams enter new markets and scale existing operations. Coordinate with Finance and Recruiting to support hiring and team changes. Build manager effectiveness. Coach managers at all levels, from first-time managers to experienced people managers, on feedback, difficult conversations, team dynamics and accountability. Help them address everyday people challenges with clarity and care. Build capability and succession. Help managers identify skills and development needs across GTM teams. Partner on talent reviews, succession planning, internal mobility and development, with particular attention to roles essential to customer and business outcomes. Drive performance and rewards decisions. Help managers set clear expectations, address underperformance and recognise contributions consistently. Partner with Compensation and Sales Compensation specialists on people implications of incentive structures, role changes and rewards decisions. Lead through regional complexity. Guide organisational changes and sensitive employee matters across EMEA, partnering with Employment Legal and Employee Relations specialists. Balance business urgency, local requirements and fair, consistent treatment. Use insight to act early. Combine workforce data, business context and employee feedback to identify emerging risks, test assumptions and recommend action. Track whether interventions improve capability, retention and team effectiveness. Scale effective People practices. Partner with global HRBPs and centres of expertise to evolve performance, engagement and talent programmes for EMEA, ensuring regional needs inform global decisions and local delivery remains practical. What You Bring Substantial HRBP experience. Typically 7–10+ years in HR, including at least five years supporting managers and teams in high-growth, international or complex organisations. We value the scope and impact of your experience. Commercial understanding. Experience supporting Sales and other go-to-market functions, with an understanding of enterprise sales cycles, customer-facing roles and the people implications of commercial operating models. Hands-on manager partnership. A record of supporting managers at all levels, resolving day-to-day people issues and owning delivery across a busy portfolio. You can exercise independent judgment, challenge constructively and build trusted relationships. EMEA experience. Experience across multiple EMEA markets, navigating cultural differences and varied employment environments, with sound judgment about when to involve specialist partners. Organisational and talent judgment. Practical experience supporting team growth, workforce planning, manager coaching, performance management and talent development, including delivering change through ambiguity. Analytical and execution strength. The ability to diagnose problems using data and context, make clear recommendations and follow through. You prioritise effectively, take ownership of complex people issues and stay close to the details through resolution. Integrity and care. Discretion with sensitive matters, fairness in decision-making and a willingness to listen, adapt and act with conviction. Workplace and Location This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model with three days per week in the office and offer relocation support where appropriate. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Location - UK Role Summary As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Cloudflare, you will serve as a senior technical expert and advisor for our most strategic and complex customers. This role balances deep technical expertise with hands-on, onsite engagement, where you will architect solutions, optimize performance, and drive business success by helping customers maximize the value of Cloudflare’s platform. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs and influence our product roadmap. We are looking for a seasoned technologist who thrives on solving real-world challenges and acting as a trusted advisor within our customers' unique environments. Role Responsibilities Serve as a trusted advisor to key enterprise customers, providing strategic recommendations and technical insights to drive success with Cloudflare’s solutions, specifically Workers and Workers AI platforms. Lead architectural discussions, design sessions, and solution reviews to ensure the optimal application of Cloudflare’s offerings in customer environments. Diagnose complex technical issues and deliver effective, strategic solutions in close collaboration with support and product teams. Manage and navigate complex configurations, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to ensure operational stability for customers. Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Partners, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure customer insights directly influence the product roadmap and enhance the overall experience. Advise customers on industry best practices for security, network optimization, scalability, and performance tuning tailored to their specific operational needs. Stay current with industry trends and evolving Cloudflare solutions to provide forward-thinking guidance and configuration enhancements. Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills) In Depth Experience in a technical customer-facing role such as Solutions Architect or Technical Account Manager, ideally within cloud networking, security, or web infrastructure. Extensive knowledge of Cloudflare’s Application and Security portfolio (DNS, WAF, DDoS, Bot Management, CDN) and cloud infrastructure. Hands-on experience protecting and securing web applications, APIs, and web services using WAF, DDoS, DNS, and Bot Management tools. Proven ability to work with Cloudflare products within Enterprise-level accounts. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong consultative skills with a track record of successfully solving complex technical problems in customer environments. Ability to translate customer requirements into practical, scalable solutions that align with Cloudflare’s technology stack. Nice-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience with coding, Cloudflare Workers, and Workers AI. Prior experience in customer onsite placement.     What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This role is available for candidates located in Canada. (Remote) The Opportunity: Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack. The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics , Loki for logs , Tempo for traces , and Pyroscope for profiles . Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on Prometheus , Grafana Alloy , Mimir proxies , and OpenTelemetry. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability. Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives. Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve. Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers. Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope. Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running. Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions, and collaborate with the team. Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system. As we are remote-first and our engineering organisation is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must. What Makes You a Great Fit: You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs . Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively. Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must. Requirements: Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well. Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements and brainstorming ideas, all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way. Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering. Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others. Bonus Points For: Experience writing low level code for databases, storage layers, or query engines. Experience working with Kubernetes. Been a user of Grafana and/or Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools in hobby/homelab projects). Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn. Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code. descriptionAr: Über uns Think3DDD ist ein Unternehmen aus Berlin-Adlershof , das sich auf 3D-Scan, 3D-Druck und Softwarelösungen im Bereich Medizintechnik spezialisiert hat. Wir entwickeln digitale Anwendungen, die Orthopädietechnikerinnen und Orthopädietechniker bei der Herstellung individueller medizinischer Hilfsmittel unterstützen. Dazu gehören die Verarbeitung von 3D-Scans, die Gestaltung von Orthesen und die Vorbereitung für den 3D-Druck. Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Software suchen wir Studierende, die sich für Frontend-Entwicklung, UX/UI-Design und 3D-Technologien interessieren und praktische Erfahrungen in diesen Bereichen sammeln möchten. Aufgaben Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung einer interaktiven Webanwendung mit three.js, React, JavaScript und CSS Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen für Orthopädietechnikerinnen und Orthopädietechniker, beispielsweise Messwerkzeuge, Marker und Slider Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von 3D-Reverse-Engineering-Workflows , einschließlich Import, Ausrichtung, Segmentierung, Mesh-Reparatur und Export von 3D-Dateien Mitarbeit bei der Performance-Optimierung und Umsetzung von Responsive Design Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus der Orthopädietechnik , um die Benutzerfreundlichkeit der Software zu verbessern Dokumentation und Präsentation der Arbeitsergebnisse im Team Bei entsprechenden Vorkenntnissen: Unterstützung bei Backend-Aufgaben mit Python Qualifikationen Laufendes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich, z. Vorrangig für Pflichtpraktika laut Studien-/Prüfungsordnung ( Dauer nach Vorgabe deiner Hochschule ). Ebenfalls möglich: Abschlussarbeit (Bachelor/Master) oder ein freiwilliges, studienbegleitendes Praktikum von höchstens 3 Monaten . Die konkreten Aufgaben, Lernziele und die fachliche Betreuung werden vor Beginn des Praktikums gemeinsam abgestimmt. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. An overview of this role As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers. You'll support work such as: Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines Flaky and slow test detection systems Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions What you’ll do Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production. Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize. Mentor intermediate engineers through code review, design feedback, and pairing. Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis. Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end. Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly. Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely. Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale. Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction. Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review. Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output. Optional experience: Rails; developer productivity, engineering analytics, or internal tooling; GitLab's product and open source contribution workflow; data pipelines or metrics reporting; or agent-based workflows that run in production. descriptionAr: McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle. Vos missions Votre mission Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing) Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale. Vos principales responsabilités Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ; Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ; Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ; Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ; Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ; Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ; Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ; Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ; Tenir à jour la documentation interne ; Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures. Organisation du travail et horaires Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe. Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ; À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ; Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ; Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation. Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit. L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends. Vos compétences Profil recherché Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ; Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ; Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ; Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ; Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ; Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ; Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ; Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail. Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise. La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne. Avantages Conditions proposées CDI à temps plein annualisé ; Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ; Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ; Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ; Formation technique assurée en interne ; Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd. Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. descriptionAr: Über Best Talents Find, hire and retain the best talent. Recruiting ist unsere Kernkompetenz. Best Talents Consulting GmbH ist eine Recruiting- und Interim-Recruiting-Beratung aus Berlin. Wir beraten unsere Mandanten (Start-ups, Scale-ups, KMU und Konzerne) in operativen und strategischen Fragestellungen von A-Z (Recruiting, Active Sourcing, Interim Recruiting, Business Coaching, Outplacement, Trainings und HR Management) und helfen ihnen dabei, die besten am Markt verfügbaren Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten zu finden. Unser Modell: Wir arbeiten auf Stundenbasis statt auf Provision – transparent, partnerschaftlich und ohne Vermittlungsgebühr. Unser erfahrenes Berater-Team besetzt deutschlandweit erfolgreich verschiedenste Positionen (von Geschäftsführerin und C-Level über Fach- und Führungskräfte bis hin zum Azubi) in diversen Branchen (E-Commerce, Retail, SaaS/Tech, Maschinenbau oder Logistik uvm.) bei namhaften Kunden (Flink, Flip, Hermès, Zalando, Zeppelin, RIMOWA, FactFinder, TWAICE, uvm.). Du bist gerade mitten im Studium und auf der Suche nach einem flexiblen Werkstudentenjob oder einem Praktikum im Recruiting, den Du 100 % Remote ausüben kannst? Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Recruiting oder Active Sourcing gesammelt und möchtest sie jetzt in echten Mandaten vertiefen? Du hast Spaß am direkten Kontakt mit Bewerbern und möchtest uns im täglichen Rennen um neue Talente unterstützen? Dann lies unbedingt weiter. Zur Verstärkung unseres Recruiting Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent oder Praktikant Recruiting / Active Sourcing (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland. In dieser Position arbeitest Du eng mit unserem Senior Recruiter zusammen. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich das Active Sourcing für spannende Positionen bei namhaften Kunden – vor allem Sales-, GTM- und Tech-Rollen bei Start-ups und Scale-ups. Eine grandiose Candidate Experience zu gestalten ist für Dich hierbei selbstverständlich. Unser Must-have: Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing. Alles andere lässt sich lernen – und wir passen den Job Deinen Stärken an. Deine Aufgaben: Du übernimmst das Active Sourcing via LinkedIn (Recruiter) und XING eigenständig, baust Suchstrings und Talent-Pools auf und unterstützt beim Kandidatenscreening. Du verwaltest, pflegst und organisierst die Kandidaten-Pipeline im ATS (z. B. Personio, Ashby), stehst im aktiven Austausch mit nationalen sowie internationalen Talenten (Terminvereinbarung, Nachforderung fehlender Informationen, Absagen) und sorgst mit Deiner professionellen Bewerberkommunikation für eine positive Candidate Experience. Du erstellst attraktive Stellenanzeigen, die im Gedächtnis bleiben (wenn Du gleich einen Vorschlag für diese Anzeige hast, nur her damit ;-)). Du kannst Deine Kreativität in verschiedenen Projekten mit dem Schwerpunkt Recruiting, Employer Branding und KI-gestütztes Sourcing einbringen. Du bist stets auf der Suche nach neuen, innovativen Direct-Search-Kanälen und hilfst uns bei der Weiterentwicklung von zielgruppenspezifischen Recruiting-Strategien. Du hast darüber hinaus weitere Ideen, wie Du uns optimal unterstützen kannst? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen, wir freuen uns auf den Austausch mit Dir! Deine Skills: Must-haves: Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Recruiting gesammelt – z. B. als Werkstudent:in, Praktikant:in oder in einer HR-Rolle – idealerweise im Active Sourcing / Direct Search über LinkedIn oder XING. Du bist an einer anerkannten (Fach-)Hochschule immatrikuliert (Werkstudium) oder suchst ein Pflicht- bzw. freiwilliges Praktikum (3–6 Monate). Die Fachrichtung ist zweitrangig. Du wohnst in Deutschland (Voraussetzung für die Anstellung) und arbeitest remote. Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher (mind. C1), Deine Englischkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher. Du hast ca. 20 Stunden die Woche Zeit, um uns zu unterstützen (Praktikum in Voll- oder Teilzeit möglich). Was uns außerdem wichtig ist: Du bist neugierig, hast Lust auf das Thema Recruiting und Talent Acquisition, kannst Dir schnell neue Themen aneignen und würdest lieber heute als morgen loslegen. Du scheust Dich nicht, Dinge zu hinterfragen und hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an Deine Arbeit. Du hast sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift. Du kennst Deine Stärken und erkennst schnell, wie Du diese einbringen kannst und uns optimal unterstützt. Du hast Spaß daran, selbstständig zu arbeiten, bist dienstleistungsorientiert sowie flexibel. Unsere Benefits: Attraktive Stundenvergütung + erfolgsabhängiger Bonus bei entsprechender Erfahrung oder Praktikumsvergütung 20 bezahlte Urlaubstage pro Jahr (bei 20 Std./Woche), damit Du neben Studium und Arbeit eine optimale Erholung bekommst. Arbeit zu 100 % Remote in Deutschland – optional Treffen mit dem Team in Berlin. Maximale Flexibilität in Bezug auf Deine Arbeitszeiten – uns ist es egal, wann Du Deine Arbeit erledigst. Hauptsache die Qualität stimmt! Abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag, vielfältige Aufgaben, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, offene, transparente Kommunikation und steile Lernkurve – Du siehst den kompletten Recruiting-Prozess von der Suche bis zur Einstellung. Professionelles Tool-Setup: LinkedIn Recruiter, moderne ATS und KI-Tools im Sourcing-Alltag. Unterschiedliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – lass uns das individuell für Dich festlegen. Viel Raum zur persönlichen Entfaltung und zum eigenverantwortlichen Arbeiten in Deiner neuen Rolle. Arbeit in einem kleinen, erfahrenen Team sowie die Möglichkeit, Deine individuellen Stärken und Ideen einzubringen. Chance, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung aktiv mitzugestalten und das Thema Recruiting neu zu denken! Auf Wunsch ist Vollbeschäftigung in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit möglich. descriptionAr: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: Manage a number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan. Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment. Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. Own a consumption revenue target. Manage consumption revenue forecasts. Analyse key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience including: 10+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service. Have full professional fluency in both French and English. Achieving revenue targets >$2M per year for more than 3 years. Designing and executing complex deal strategies. Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. Working directly with c-level executives. Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You might thrive in this role if you: Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organisation. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal  About the Role:   Do you thrive in a high performance role, solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our team PAYGO. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will provide support on our Application Performance and Developer Platform products.    Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience: You thrive in a high performing team environment You take ownership and make sure you solve the customers issues.  You drive the case to the finish line. You are familiar with Developer Platform products You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role You have experience solving HTTP, DNS, SSL, Cache and other networking-related problems You understand how the Internet works You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump) You have experience working in a support role. You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and virtual meetings) You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set Bonus Points You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS / CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €28,000-39,000.  Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.   What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. We are looking to hire the best talent around the Globe, so wherever you are, feel free to reach out. Who you are: MUST HAVE: Rail industry experience. Hands-on experience with PICO API, OSDM, or other European rail carrier and transportation industry standards. Management skills: solid grounding across product, process, project, and people management, developed within cross-functional teams. Background: technical or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; fluent in English, both verbal and written. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Dubai, UAE About the role The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically META. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation What you'll do Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory (META) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota. Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get. Work closely with other teams: Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline. Run your territory with data: Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as:  BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota  Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC  Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc) Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset   Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. descriptionAr: A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further. The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA. At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere. We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media. Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will. You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go. Your stories need to travel beyond the cage. Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further. A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage. You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care. Here’s what you’ll take ownership of: Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want. Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar. Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial formats. Know where a story will work and adapt it accordingly. Create sharp German press materials. Write press releases, translate and localise event Media Info Cards, research fight cards and prepare tailored angles for individual outlets. Make interviews happen. Connect journalists with fighters, coordinate opportunities and prepare written interviews when needed. Get the right assets into the right hands. Distribute photos, video and relevant information, including captioned fight photography for dpa-picture alliance and Imago. Keep the foundations organised. Own accreditations, maintain the media database and keep fighter information accurate and up to date. Show what your work achieves. Monitor online and offline coverage, prepare monthly reports and summarise results after German events. Use what you learn to improve the next campaign. Keep our communication connected. Work closely with the PR lead, Marketing DE and Social Media so our messaging stays consistent, including across German-language video content. When fight week starts, you’re in the middle of it. The plans are ready. The journalists arrive. Interview requests change. A result creates a new headline. You’ll be the person who keeps media operations moving. At German events, that means overseeing accreditations and the media room, coordinating interviews, supporting weigh-ins and press conferences, and making sure journalists have what they need before and after the fights. Where needed, you may also moderate a press conference. You’ll handle post-fight releases, follow-ups and coverage reviews. During selected events outside Germany, you’ll be available for relevant German media requests and breaking stories. And when a sensitive situation comes up, you’ll be the first point of contact for German media, working closely with the PR lead on the response. This role includes travel and weekend work. Fight weeks can run from Thursday through Sunday, and you need to be comfortable with the pace and responsibility that come with live events. What you bring into the team You already know how a newsroom works. You understand deadlines, editorial judgement and the difference between a story we want to tell and a story someone will want to publish. We’re looking for: At least 2–4 years of relevant experience in PR or sports journalism. You’ve pitched stories, worked with journalists and delivered under pressure. An existing network in German sports newsrooms. Relationships you can build on, alongside the initiative to open new doors. Native-level German and very good English. Your German writing is precise, natural and adaptable. You’re comfortable collaborating with an international team in English. Strong editorial instincts. You can spot an angle, ask the useful question and turn a complicated story into a clear pitch. Digital confidence. You understand how people discover and consume stories today and stay curious about what is changing. Independence and ownership. You can organise your work remotely, follow through on commitments and keep colleagues informed. Willingness to travel and work weekends. You want to be there when the action happens. An interest in MMA or combat sports, experience with press conferences and crisis communication, and a driving licence are all advantages. You don’t need to know every fighter’s record on day one. You'll need to be technically credible in authentication protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Make sure the team runs what it builds, including on-call coverage, incident response for authentication issues, rate limits, and production readiness for new services. Build a team culture where security comes first, decisions are written down, and code review is thorough and kind. Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers. An overview of this role We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer. This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives. What you'll do Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion. Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them. Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage. Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD. Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services. Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback. Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers. Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily. Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation. Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back. A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains. Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers. Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement. descriptionAr: Overview ClickHouse is seeking an experienced commercial lawyer to join ClickHouse’s elite and business-focused Legal team. Cultivate strong relationships with the EMEA sales team and act as a solutions-oriented business partner to ClickHouse’s EMEA sales team by providing pragmatic, sound legal counsel. Negotiate complex cross-border transactions with sophisticated counterparties located across multiple jurisdictions, with increasing ownership of complex deals. Monitor and advise on relevant regulatory, compliance, or legal developments impacting the business in the EMEA region, and partner with the broader Legal team and cross-functional stakeholders where required. Provide training and enablement to internal stakeholders on legal issues and contract processes. Help maintain and update our legal agreements, policies, and templates; develop and improve scalable workflows to enable rapid revenue growth and stability for the company. As an early member of ClickHouse’s EMEA legal function, contribute to building the playbooks, templates, and processes the region will run on, with mentorship and support from the broader Legal team. What You Bring Along: Qualified lawyer in good standing in the UK or another European jurisdiction, with the right to work in the hiring location; local qualification (or active pursuit of it) a plus. 3-6 years of law firm and/or in-house experience. Experience supporting high growth infrastructure SaaS companies is a plus. Exceptional academic performance and training, including a law degree from a highly ranked university and/or experience at a top-tier law firm in the technology space. Proven experience drafting, negotiating, and closing complex commercial technology transactions and SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, partners, and resellers across multiple jurisdictions. International legal experience is a plus. Strong understanding of commercial legal issues related to SaaS and software licensing (i.e., data privacy, security, intellectual property, open-source, revenue recognition, and tax), professional services, and other go-to-market programs (such as partner/reseller programs). Excellent judgement, strong business orientation, and ability to translate legal risk into practical commercial advice within the context of business objectives. Strong interpersonal, communication, and management skills; ability to build trust and strong relationships with ClickHouse’s sales team, cross-functional stakeholders, and ClickHouse’s customers. Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Experience negotiating on customer paper and working with negotiation playbooks and fallback positions is a plus. Fluency in additional European languages is a plus. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Can reason about complex hardware systems, identify performance bottlenecks, and translate architectural requirements into efficient RTL implementations. Have experience with synthesis, timing closure, and physical implementation considerations. Enjoy working on ambiguous, technically challenging problems and taking ownership of designs from concept through integration. descriptionAr: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the role: We are looking for an Engineering Manager, Security to lead the teams that secure our cloud, our infrastructure, and the code we ship. You will manage two closely linked groups: Cloud & Infrastructure Security : engineers who own cloud security posture, configuration hardening, and infrastructure vulnerability management across GCP, AWS, and Azure, plus containers, Kubernetes, and SaaS platforms. Application Security & Secure SDLC : engineers who run our SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs, drive remediation with engineering teams, and deliver secure development training. The core responsibility of this role is getting vulnerabilities fixed on time . You will partner with engineering teams across the company to drive remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and code findings within SLA, so that we consistently meet our compliance commitments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and customer contracts). You will hire and grow a high-performing team, set the strategy and roadmap for vulnerability management from code to cloud, and make secure-by-default the easiest path for every developer. You will not run incident response yourself, but you need to understand it well enough to support the incident response team with context, prioritization, and follow-up fixes. What You'll Do: Team Leadership & Strategy Build, lead, and mentor a team of cloud security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and application security engineers; own hiring, career development, and performance management. Define the multi-year roadmap and quarterly OKRs for cloud security, vulnerability management, and Secure SDLC, balancing risk reduction against developer velocity. Set clear ownership, operating rhythms, and on-call/escalation processes across the team. Report on security posture, risk trends, and program metrics to engineering and executive leadership. Remediation & Compliance Delivery Own remediation SLAs by severity across cloud, infrastructure, container, and code findings, and make sure they map to our compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, customer contracts). Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to plan, prioritize, and land fixes within SLA without stalling roadmaps. Run a regular remediation review with engineering leadership: open findings, SLA burn-down, upcoming SLA breaches, and owners. Manage the exception and risk-acceptance process: documented justification, compensating controls, expiry dates, and approvals. Build automated workflows that route findings to the right owning team, track them to closure, and escalate before SLAs are breached. Work with Compliance/GRC to produce audit-ready evidence of remediation timeliness, and lead the security side of external audits for vulnerability management controls. Track and report metrics such as SLA attainment, mean time to remediate, backlog age, and exceptions, by team and severity. Cloud & Infrastructure Security Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud workloads, containers, registries, data stores, and platform services, from scanning and contextual risk triage to remediation workflows. Oversee configuration hardening and secure baselines across GCP (primary) and supporting AWS and Azure environments. Own the strategy for Cloud, Kubernetes, and Data Security Posture Management (CSPM, KSPM, DSPM) tooling; make sure findings are accurate, prioritized, and actionable. Secure critical SaaS platforms with sound configurations, access controls, and integrations. Partner with Platform and ML Infrastructure teams to secure multi-tenant and AI infrastructure. Application Security & Code Scanning Own the SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs end to end: tool selection, CI/CD integration, rule tuning, noise reduction, and developer experience. Drive software supply chain security, including dependency management, SBOMs, artifact signing, and progress through SLSA levels. Feed code-scanning findings into the central remediation workflow so they reach the owning team automatically and are tracked against SLA. Shift IaC security left so misconfigurations are caught in pull requests, before they reach production. Secure SDLC & Developer Enablement Define and run the Secure SDLC program: security requirements, threat modeling, secure design reviews, and release gates proportionate to risk. Build and deliver security training, including onboarding, role-based secure coding training, and targeted sessions driven by real vulnerability trends. Develop paved roads, secure defaults, and guardrails that make the secure path the easiest path for engineers. Grow a Security Champions network across engineering teams. Incident Response Partnership & Collaboration Understand the incident response lifecycle well enough to support the IR team: supply asset, exposure, and vulnerability context, and help assess blast radius. Own follow-up remediation from incidents and postmortems that touch cloud, infrastructure, or code, and track it to closure. Feed incident learnings back into scanning rules, secure baselines, and developer training. Collaborate with Security Monitoring/Detection, Incident Response, Offensive Security, PSIRT, Architecture, DevOps, and Platform Engineering. Help communicate security advisories, best practices, and updates to customers. Tune into threat intelligence alerts to promptly manage patching of critical, exploitable vulnerabilities. Required Skills & Experience: 8+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or DevSecOps, including 2+ years managing security engineers (or 3+ years as a tech lead with formal people-leadership responsibility). Deep, hands-on knowledge of cloud security in GCP plus working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure

SUPPORT OPERATIONS SYSTEMS LEAD We're hiring a Support Operations Systems Lead to help own the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that keep User Operations running reliably at scale. This is a hands-on technical support operations role for someone who can move fluidly between live triage of our projects, backlog management of internal requests, systems health, stakeholder communication, and end-to-end program ownership. You'll work across ticketing workflows, routing logic, queue health, labeling taxonomy, escalation paths, workforce signals, and internal tooling requests. issues as they arise, especially when system behavior, workforce distribution, queue health, or SLA risk looks off Manage intake, prioritization, and follow-through for systems requests from support managers, TSEs, operations leads, engineering, product, and other internal teams Help maintain the team's roadmap by distinguishing one-off fixes from broader system improvements, surfacing recurring pain points, and pushing back on low-leverage work Drive smaller technical and operational programs end-to-end, being responsible for discovery, scoping and execution, rollout, documentation and success metrics Partner with engineering, data, IT, and support leaders to debug issues, validate changes, improve monitoring, and prevent repeat failures Use SpaceXSI and AI-native workflows to reduce manual toil, investigate issues, summarize signals, draft documentation, test changes, and improve how the team operates BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Experience in support operations, systems operations, technical program management, or a similarly cross-functional technical systems role PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience working with operational systems such as ticketing platforms, routing workflows, queue configuration, labels/taxonomies, dashboards, Slack workflows, and internal tools Technical skills to investigate system issues, read configuration or code, and partner effectively with engineers Excellent at triage and prioritization: when several things are broken or ambiguous, you can quickly determine what is urgent, what needs investigation, what needs escalation, and what should become a longer-term fix Able to own work end to end: clarify the problem, align stakeholders, sequence the work, communicate tradeoffs, launch safely, and measure whether the change worked Comfortable pushing back thoughtfully and can tell stakeholders "not yet," "not this way," or "this should be part of a broader fix" while maintaining trust Energized by a role that blends firefighting with systems-building, and you have a strong bias toward action, clarity, and continuous improvement ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Remote role (United States) COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. Annual Salary: $118,000 - $145,000 USD Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. ENGINEERING MANAGER, AGENT & PRODUCT SECURITY Cursor's agents work inside the codebases of some of the most security-conscious engineering organizations in the world, holding credentials, reading untrusted content, running tools, and shipping changes. Today they act on authority delegated per task. Where we're headed, they'll work more like coworkers: autonomous over long horizons, holding standing responsibilities, initiating work, and collaborating with people and other agents. The security models that the future needs, identity and accountability for autonomous workers, standing authority rather than per-task permission, agent-to-agent trust, oversight that scales with always-on autonomy, mostly don't exist yet. RESPONSIBILITIES: Chart the path from supervised agents to trusted autonomous ones: define the security primitives that enable agent autonomy, and lead the team that builds them Engineer the isolation that makes Cursor safe to run inside customers' most valuable codebases: tenancy, workspace, secret, and data protections designed for real adversaries Build the authority infrastructure autonomous agents need: identity, scoped permissions, policy enforcement, and secure tool execution, so an agent can hold real responsibility with verifiable limits and full accountability Build customer-facing security controls that are understandable, usable, and strong enough for Cursor's most security-sensitive customers, with crisp success metrics for security outcomes Hire, coach, and grow a high-performing security engineering team while staying technically close to the work: write and review code where useful, and keep execution fast and technically grounded BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Experience leading engineering teams that ship production systems with high security, reliability, or platform stakes PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Wants a problem space where much of the answer isn't written down yet Experience leading engineering teams shipping production systems with high security, reliability, or platform stakes, and you want a problem space where much of the answer isn't written down yet Strong product and systems judgment: you can reason from user workflows to architecture, threat models, enforcement points, and operational tradeoffs, and you see security as something that enables product capability, rather than only restricting it Understand modern application security, authorization, tenancy, identity, secrets, data isolation, and secure-by-default platform design Good instincts about AI agents: how they use tools, where authority should come from, how prompt injection and exfiltration show up in practice, and how to build mitigations that hold up against creative adversaries Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can set strategy where precedent is thin, commit to a direction, and stay close enough to the implementation to know when to change it Able to partner well across product, infrastructure, ML, and customer-facing teams ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Onsite role based in New York or Palo Alto COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. Annual Salary: $220,000 - $357,000 USD Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation. Proactive engineering. Available Locations: Austin or London About the Role TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel. That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically.  Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today. As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt. This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building.
