Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. FIELD MARKETING MANAGER As our founding Field Marketer, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for the Japan region, responsible for translating our global strategy into localized, high-impact programs to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts. We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with the Sales Team and flawless execution of experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline impact from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter that thrives at the intersection of technical innovation and enterprise GTM, we want you! RESPONSIBILITIES: Design the Regional Playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan tailored to your region's specific needs, focusing on the largest enterprise accounts Master the Land & Expand: Own the regional pipeline target. You will deploy a mix of high-touch events, executive roundtables, thought leadership roadshows, industry tradeshows, and account-based activations to identify and accelerate opportunities that ensure wall-to-wall adoption in our highest potential accounts Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable experiences across in person, virtual and next gen marketing formats as well as the operational workflows that bring them to life. Be ready and eager to break the mold and go big! Big Picture Operator: Be excited to bring the SpaceXSI mission and story to our customers by partnering with corporate marketing to ensure sharp messaging at every touchpoint Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Regional Sales Teams. You'll lead marketing planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze regional pipeline trends, ensure absolute alignment on account priorities and maximize the adoption and impact of all marketing efforts Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program with total ownership, from ideation, to promotion, to vendor management, to onsite experience, and follow-up, going beyond just day-of execution Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your regional budget with a focus on high-impact investments Feedback Loop: Serve as the "eyes and ears" of the field. Provide the Corporate Marketing teams with real-time feedback, needs and ideas on messaging resonance and competitive shifts BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ years of experience in Field or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS Fluency in both English and Japanese PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Understand the complexity of selling to the CTO, VP of Engineering, and CISO The Revenue Mindset: You don't care about "leads"; you care about pipeline and ARR. You speak the language of sales and aren't afraid to be held to a pipeline number The "Gritty" Optimizer: You are a self-starter who can build a program from a blank sheet of paper and then obsessively optimize it based on the data Whether it's writing a personalized invite to a CIO or presenting a quarterly business review (QBR) to leadership, your communication is sharp, professional, and persuasive ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Remote role (Japan)

About the Role As a Product Engagement Manager on the User Operations team, you will lead a team of Product Engagement Specialists responsible for ensuring smooth, successful product launches across internal and external teams. You’ll be the glue connecting product teams and support operations, equipping teams with the tools and knowledge needed to support new product rollouts. You’ll build scalable feedback loops that capture the voice of the user and translate insights into actionable product improvements, and ensure that frontline teams have the knowledge and skills to deliver accurate, delightful customer interactions at scale. We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and who enjoys working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This person will manage the day-to-day work while also helping architect the systems needed to scale it. The successful candidate will be a leader-coach who can lead a small team while continuing to perform individual contributor work. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Lead a team coordinating product launches across internal and external teams, ensuring seamless execution and support readiness. Set the team’s strategy and priorities, translate them into clear goals and quality standards, and allocate capacity to deliver against them. Build a high-performing team through ongoing coaching, feedback, development, and performance management. Build out a Voice of the User program with scalable feedback loops between support, Product, and Engineering pre and post launch, so customer insights inform product development and strategy. Advocate for users by representing their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions. Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to align on launch goals and timelines. Monitor post-launch performance and gather support data to assess product impact and inform improvements. Document and standardize launch procedures to make them repeatable and scalable. Identify launch risks and propose solutions that minimize disruption to customers. Report on feedback-loop performance, including key insights, trends, and recommendations for the product roadmap. You might thrive in this role if you: Have experience leading product enablement or launch-readiness functions at scale, particularly in a customer support environment. Have shipped tooling or automations that reduced manual work and scaled beyond a single team (workflows, dashboards, scripted automation, lightweight pipelines)." Have experience in product management with automation and tool development, using metrics and feedback to improve decisions and processes. Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams. Are passionate about customer advocacy and can translate customer feedback into strategic product insights. Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. Communicate technical concepts and customer pain points clearly to diverse audiences. Take ownership of initiatives from ideation through implementation and post-launch analysis. Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Map buying centers inside each account (VP Eng, CTO, platform and developer experience leads, security and procurement) and build multithreaded plays that reach each of them. Turn account intelligence, intent, and usage signals into tailored campaign treatments, from personalized outreach and executive programs to events, direct mail, and sales plays. Tell stories that land with technical buyers. Shape the narrative, messaging, and offers for each campaign, and write the copy that carries it: briefs, emails, landing pages, ads, and account-specific content. Develop engaging concepts and formats for virtual events (webinars, workshops, and exec roundtables), owning all aspects of production from idea to follow-up: select relevant topics, line up speakers from internal leaders and our customers, and make sure everyone is prepared. Brief design and creative partners clearly and keep the story consistent across every channel and touchpoint. Conceptualize and deploy creative demand gen offers Come up with offers that give target accounts a reason to engage, like meeting makers, direct mail, digital engagement programs, and gifting. Work with sales and SDRs on who gets each offer and how they follow up, and manage vendors on fulfillment, shipping, and budget. Track every offer from send to meeting to pipeline so we know what to repeat. Build thoughtful email campaigns and nurture programs Develop and improve nurture sequences for prospects and customers, segmented by persona, account tier, and where they are in the journey. Write and edit email copy, analyze performance, and come up with new ideas for content angles and CTAs that improve engagement. Partner with our lifecycle and email owners to keep lists clean, segments accurate, and every send on brand. Execute the deliverables that bring campaigns to life. Turn campaign plans into finished work: write briefs for design, and build landing pages, emails, ads, and sales one-pagers. Own launch checklists and timelines, coordinate with design, web, ops, and sales, and ship on time. Report on how each campaign performed, share what you learned with the team and sales, and suggest what to try next. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 3 to 5 years in B2B marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations, with hands-on time supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for enterprise or technical audiences. Hands-on experience supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for B2B enterprise or technical audiences Experience writing and executing email nurture campaigns in a marketing automation platform PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: You're both left-brained and right-brained: as comfortable debating pipeline math as you are coming up with a creative campaign idea. You write well. You can tell a compelling story, write copy that makes a busy engineering leader keep reading, and you have strong instincts for what good looks like. You've supported ABM or integrated campaigns and understand the basics of account selection, buying groups, and multithreading in enterprise deals. You're organized and detail-oriented, and you can juggle many deliverables and deadlines without dropping any. You like working closely with sales, and you know how to earn trust with sellers. You want ownership and high agency, and you'd rather ship and learn than wait for perfect information. You can take a loose plan, bring structure to it, and get it shipped. You're curious about AI and developer tools, and you use AI in your own workflow every day. Hands-on experience running webinars, direct mail or meeting-maker programs, and email nurture. Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, a marketing automation platform, webinar platforms, direct mail or gifting platforms, and Clay or ABM and intent platforms. Bonus if you've used AI coding tools to query data yourself. E

descriptionAr: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist (German Speaking) Hi! I'm Daryl, and I'm the Manager of High Touch (Mid-Market) Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite things about this team is that we're the first real proof point for a new customer; from day 1, we get the hands-on opportunity to show them why they made the right call switching to Ashby. The Ashby team has grown rapidly over the last few years, and we're not slowing down: we added more than 2,100 new customers in the last year alone and now support over 5,000 customers, with ARR growing much faster than 100% year over year. We're expecting similarly fast growth this year, and every one of those new customers needs a thoughtful implementation to actually get value out of Ashby. We'll share more details once we meet, but you probably have a good idea as to why we're expanding this team! The Role: We're looking for a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist who excels at leading technically complex, hands on implementation projects for B2B SaaS customers. descriptionAr: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies. The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development. As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights. Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI. This role is open in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts. Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption. Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures. Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges. Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities. Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development. Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams. Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering. Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact. Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries. You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles. Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers. Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments. Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions. Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles. Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed. Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is, at its core, a fintech company. Our financial infrastructure enables us to issue cards, move money globally, and manage treasury flows for our customers. Stablecoins are emerging as a critical lever to make these flows faster, cheaper, and more accessible. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team with a dedicated focus on stablecoin-based payment and treasury systems. In this role, you will act as both a technical owner and multiplier: working on core stablecoin services, ensuring secure and reliable integrations with external partners, and guiding Ramp’s evolution toward next-generation fintech solutions. Our ideal candidate combines deep curiosity about eventually consistent distributed systems with strong financial infrastructure experience, thrives in highly regulated and mission-critical environments, and has a passion for diving into new problem spaces. What You'll Do Help build & scale Ramp’s stablecoin-based payment and treasury infrastructure Partner with external providers and internal stakeholders to deliver end-to-end product flows Solve Ramp’s toughest fintech challenges with new technologies Collaborate with engineers across Ramp to integrate stablecoin capabilities into core products What You Need Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping high-quality architectures for critical systems preferred Proven experience with stablecoin technologies, blockchain-based payment rails, and/or wallet infrastructure Strong production experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or equivalent) Deep proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (Python, Go, Java, or similar) Experience working on security-sensitive systems, with interest in key management, wallet security, or secure transaction flows. Experience building or operating payments, money movement, treasury, stablecoin, or crypto infrastructure in production environments Nice to Have Intuition for on-chain UX and settlement mechanics, including wallet-based transaction signing, confirmation/finality, and chain-level tradeoffs like fees and latency. Direct experience building on-chain wallets or with integrating a crypto onramp / offramp APIs for custody and remittance flows Experience integrating with external financial service providers and APIs at scale Familiarity with cross-border settlement, FX, or treasury management systems Background in highly regulated fintech environments (e.g., payments, banking, or government-compliant infrastructure) Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global) Flexible PTO Centralized home-office equipment ordering Health and wellness stipend Budget for intra-office travel Weekly coffee stipend United States 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents One Medical annual membership 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay Pet insurance In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) Canada Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life Life, AD&D, and disability coverage Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health United Kingdom Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay Referral Instructions If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation. RESPONSIBILITIES: Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Remote role (United States) Must be willing to travel 40-50% COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,500 - $210,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan. Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

Data & Systems Management: Leverage financial systems (e.g., NetSuite, Google Sheets/Excel, Pigment) to ensure data accuracy, streamline processes, and improve reporting efficiency. Workforce Planning: Support organization-wide workforce planning by developing and maintaining the workforce model, and establishing and refining key headcount and compensation assumptions. This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, or related quantitative field. An MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus. 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A with an emphasis on budget management and running month end operations. Expert level Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling skills; familiarity with ERP systems. Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, including effective communication skills at all levels within the Company and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to deliver change, improve and streamline processes, drive efficiency, and influence stakeholders. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, constantly involving environments. Startup/scaleup experience is a plus. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. We want someone who knows their channels inside out, enjoys getting into the details, and can take a campaign from initial hypothesis through execution, analysis, and optimization. You'll have access to specialist support when it makes sense, but you'll be the person driving the work. We also believe AI creates an opportunity for exceptional individual contributors to do work that previously required much larger teams. We're looking for someone who is already exploring that opportunity and wants to push it further. What makes this role interesting You get to build with the resources most marketers wish they had. Paid is relatively underdeveloped at Ashby compared with the scale of our business. You get to build something substantial without unwinding years of accumulated complexity or fighting for the resources to make it work. We have strong content, customer proof, product differentiation, and an established brand. You'll start with a monthly budget in the hundreds of thousands of dollars and the support of our design, web, and RevOps teams. You can rethink how paid marketing gets done. We want to enable exceptional individual contributors to accomplish more through AI, automation, and better workflows. You'll have the freedom to experiment with new tools, build systems that improve your output, and challenge established ways of working. You'll build a program that makes the brand and business stronger. We believe great paid marketing combines analytical rigor with creative judgment. You'll optimize for pipeline and efficiency while building campaigns that earn attention, communicate our differentiation, and give the right buyers a reason to care about Ashby. We don't want a lead-generation machine that makes our brand worse. What you'll own Build and scale our paid program. Own strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Search, expanding into YouTube and other channels as opportunities emerge. Prioritize audiences, develop campaign hypotheses, manage budgets, and turn promising experiments into repeatable sources of qualified pipeline. Drive creative strategy and experimentation. Develop campaign concepts, write ad copy, brief creative, and shape landing-page tests. Work closely with design, content, and product marketing to produce distinctive work. Build a disciplined testing cadence across audiences, creative, offers, and conversion paths, knowing when to scale, iterate, or stop. Use AI to increase your impact. Build practical workflows using AI, agents, and automation to improve research, creative iteration, campaign operations, and analysis. We want someone who actively experiments with new approaches, evaluates their effectiveness, and turns what works into repeatable systems. Own measurement and performance. Drive our approach to paid measurement in partnership with RevOps. Establish the signals and reporting needed to understand qualified reach, conversion, pipeline contribution, and efficiency. Develop better ways to assess incrementality, make informed decisions with imperfect attribution, and translate performance data into clear investment recommendations. Connect campaigns to the buyer journey. Partner with sales, lifecycle, and ABM to understand what makes an opportunity valuable and how paid can influence the journey from first touch through pipeline. Adapt messaging and investment to our customer segments and markets. What you'll work on in your first six months Take ownership of LinkedIn, identifying opportunities to improve qualified reach, creative, and progression into pipeline. Build and scale Meta, establishing a strong creative testing cadence and the landing pages and follow-up needed to make the channel work. Expand Google Search and launch YouTube, evaluating additional channels where there's a compelling audience and learning opportunity. Establish a stronger operating system for paid, including AI-enabled workflows, measurement, and a clear approach to allocating investment. The goal isn't to scale every channel equally. It's to build a broad set of opportunities, learn quickly, and concentrate investment where the evidence is strongest. What we're looking for We care more about what you've built and how you think than the number of years you've spent in marketing. You're a domain expert in paid media. You have deep, hands-on expertise in LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Ads. You understand the platforms, know how to structure and optimize campaigns, and can explain how your decisions have influenced qualified pipeline. You've personally built and scaled programs in sales-led B2B SaaS. You're a builder, not just a strategist. You're excited to get into the accounts, develop the creative, run experiments, investigate performance, and solve problems yourself. You know when external expertise can help, but you don't need an agency to do the core work. You combine analytical rigor with creative taste. You understand performance metrics and experimentation, but you also know what makes advertising compelling. You can connect campaign decisions to buyer quality and pipeline without losing sight of the brand you're building. You're already changing how you work with AI. You can demonstrate how you've used AI too

help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Change Record team within GitLab’s Source Code stage . As AI agents increasingly write code alongside people, every change needs a clear, trustworthy record of what changed, why, and who or what made it. You’ll build that record into GitLab’s source code experience, for humans and agents alike. This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development. That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories behind a large share of GitLab traffic, so you’ll help keep it reliable through performance tuning, caching, rate limiting, observability, and resiliency, collaborating with product, design, security, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience teams. Supporting production systems and improving established experiences are central to the role, especially while you’re onboarding, and over time you’ll also help build experiences for developers working with agents. You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland. What you’ll do Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby on Rails and GraphQL, among other technologies. Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system. Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows. Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome. Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output. Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews. Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency. Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL. An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices. Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems. Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes. Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment. The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed. Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output. Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes. About the team The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. We work closely with other Source Code teams, Agentic Preview, Repository Services, and Hardening, as well as other teams in the company such as the Gitaly team, and the AI Governance team.   The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits. Poland base salary range: 248,000zł - 372,000zł Ho

An overview of this role The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it. Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy. Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions. Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language. Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform. What you’ll do Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against. Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it. Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language. Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it. Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform. Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production. A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried. Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first. The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific. You prototype to learn, and you ship. The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning. Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency. This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it. About the team The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt. descriptionAr: About the Team The Intelligence and Investigations team is dedicated to ensuring the safe, responsible deployment of AI by rapidly detecting and mitigating abuse. Our team leverages cutting-edge testing methodologies to uncover vulnerabilities and emerging threats, helping safeguard OpenAI’s products and users. We work closely with cross-functional partners across product, policy, and engineering to drive a comprehensive defense strategy against evolving adversarial challenges. About the Role As a Novel Abuse Red Teamer, you’ll advance our pre- and post-deployment testing efforts at OpenAI, ensuring our models and products remain resilient against evolving, real-world adversarial threats. We are seeking a self-starter to design, execute, and refine innovative adversarial testing and simulation protocols that leverage state-of-the-art tools and a hands-on red team approach. In this role, you will simulate threat actor methodologies and conduct rigorous application testing to uncover novel abuse vectors. You will serve as a critical technical bridge between our security, product, and policy teams by employing an attacker mindset and advanced red team tactics to drive actionable insights that strengthen our detection mechanisms and overall product defenses. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in application security or penetration testing, with hands-on experience in web application security and proficiency in tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, and similar. We value professionals with excellent communication skills, a commitment to continuous learning, and a passion for securing AI technologies through innovative testing methodologies. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Design and execute high-fidelity, realistic attack simulations that emulate sophisticated threat actor methodologies, uncovering hidden exploitation vectors through advanced red teaming and application testing techniques. Analyze testing outcomes and generate actionable insights to refine our detection mechanisms, ultimately bolstering our overall security posture. Serve as a crucial technical bridge between our security, product, and policy teams, ensuring that insights from adversarial testing inform broader defense strategies and remediation efforts. Develop and integrate automation tools to streamline testing workflows and enable rapid iteration in response to emerging threats. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to align testing strategies with evolving product needs and security objectives. You might thrive in this role if you have / are: Experience in application security, penetration testing, or red team operations, with a proven track record of executing adversarial testing and simulation protocols. descriptionAr: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - WESTERN EUROPE You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path) PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, AI DEPLOYMENT As Regional Director, AI Deployment at SpaceXSI, you'll lead and develop a team of AI Deployment Managers supporting some of our most strategic enterprise customers. RESPONSIBILITIES: Hire, lead, and develop a team of AI Deployment, including onboarding, coaching, performance management, and ongoing skill development Own post-sale account planning, with accountability for account health, usage, risk mitigation, and expansion pipeline generation Act as an escalation point for complex deployments and high-stakes enterprise accounts; build lightweight, scalable processes that codify what works while preserving speed, flexibility, and low friction Guide best practices around rollout strategy, prompt design, context configuration, and internal enablement Partner closely with Sales and Field Engineering to deliver a seamless post-sale experience and support expansion opportunities Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to advocate for customer needs, influence roadmap priorities, and drive product adoption BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 4+ years of experience leading customer-facing technical teams in TAM, Solutions, Deployment, or similar roles Experience owning post-sale retention or renewal outcomes for enterprise software or AI platform customers PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience managing ADM, TAM, or CSM teams for developer tools, DevOps, or AI/ML platforms Familiarity with software development lifecycles and enterprise AI: AI coding tools, AI agents, and LLM APIs Experience presenting adoption and ROI results to VP Engineering, CTO, CIO, and line-of-business buyers A high-agency, scrappy operator who thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments Care deeply about AI and believe that transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: The expected annual base salary range for this role is $245,000 - $280,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

Knowledge of privacy and data protection laws (e.g. CCPA or GDPR). Prior experience in high-growth startups and/or high-growth technology companies. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.  The opportunity: As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.  Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite. You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth. As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will: Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities  Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.  Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering. What You’ll Be Doing: Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities  Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.  Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering What makes you a great fit: A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience 5+ years of experience in Product Management 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product  Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment Excellent written and verbal communicat

descriptionAr: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE - VICTORIA As a Strategic Account Executive for Victoria, you'll be one of the foundational members of SpaceXSI's enterprise sales team in the region. You'll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of SpaceXSI, owning strategic accounts across Victoria and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders. This is a rare opportunity to bring a product engineers already love into some of ANZ's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era. RESPONSIBILITIES: Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across Victoria, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue; run a disciplined, full-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close Build and execute account strategies that connect SpaceXSI's capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, and your own network; partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi-stakeholder approval cycles Serve as the voice of Australian enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership Help establish SpaceXSI's enterprise presence in Victoria by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references; consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 7+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering-led organizations Experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in Victoria Comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders A true hunter: you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, executive engagement, and persistent follow-up Strong command of pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting across a strategic book of business Energized by technical products and can hold credible conversations with senior engineers, platform leaders, and CTOs about how SpaceXSI fits into modern development workflows A self-starter who thrives in an early-stage, resource-constrained environment and can build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go Care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Staff Backend Engineer on GitLab's Core DevOps team, you'll provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams. You'll lead large backend initiatives, guide the modernization of a large monolith into modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems, and set standards that help teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability. You'll work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups. You'll lead complex backend architecture, make product trade-offs, and influence technical direction without formal authority. GitLab is an open core software company that develops an artificial intelligence-powered DevSecOps platform. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. About the role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, implement, and evolve product capabilities while solving high-scope backend problems and influencing the technical and product direction of our teams. You will move beyond "assigned work" to actively improve the quality, reliability, and performance of our systems. You will work across product, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security boundaries, making sound architectural trade-offs, communicating complex ideas clearly in an asynchronous environment, and helping define the standards for a high-scale, global product. Why you’ll love this role High Impact: You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the architecture of a global platform used by millions. Technical Agency: You will influence team objectives, technical direction, and long-range goals, helping us solve problems of high scope and complexity. Innovative Culture: You will get to experiment with and integrate agentic AI into production engineering workflows, moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build resilient, AI-assisted systems. Autonomy: You will thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success. User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, ensuring every technical decision delivers genuine value to our users. What you’ll do Drive Technical Direction: Design and ship moderate to complex backend features with minimal guidance, making pragmatic choices between modular-monolith code, shared components, or independently operated services. Raise the Bar: Advocate for product quality, security, availability, and performance. You will define backend standards for style, maintainability, testing, APIs, and operational readiness. Mentor & Lead: Mentor associate and intermediate engineers, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices through code and design reviews. Operational Excellence: Diagnose and prevent performance/reliability issues at scale. Participate in incident response and act as a technical owner where appropriate. AI Integration: Use AI in production engineering work to improve outcomes, evaluate its effectiveness, and coach others on responsible, high-judgment use. On Call Support: Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Deep Backend Expertise: A strong command of backend architecture, APIs, data systems, and performance tuning in a complex product or service environment. Adaptability: Proficiency in modern backend languages and a deep understanding of systems programming. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language. Architectural Judgment: Experience designing or evolving modular backend boundaries, bounded contexts, and migration-safe architectures. Influence: Ability to lead through influence, technical judgment, and clear written communication, effectively bridging the gap between product needs and technical reality. Agentic AI Expertise: Proven experience building or operating agentic systems in production—moving beyond prompt engineering to architecting loops, tool-use, and error-handling strategies that ensure reliability at scale. Due to customer requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position   The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. AI DEPLOYMENT MANAGER As an AI Deployment Manager (ADM) at SpaceXSI, you'll own the post-sale journey for a portfolio of enterprise customers, driving adoption, retention, and expansion. You'll help engineering organizations successfully roll out SpaceXSI and evolve how they work with AI. You'll operate at the center of each account, partnering with developers, admins, and executives while working closely with Sales, Field Engineering, Product, and Support. You'll shape rollout strategy and influence SpaceXSI's roadmap priorities through customer insight. RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage a book of business with our largest enterprise customers in the life sciences segment, owning the long-term success of each account Engage CTO / VP / SVP Engineering stakeholders to demonstrate ROI and guide AI-driven organizational change Lead enterprise rollouts end-to-end: onboarding, enablement, internal champions, and scaled adoption Turn high-impact use cases into durable, repeatable workflows across teams Monitor account health and usage data to drive renewals and expansion with AEs Represent the customer internally, synthesizing feedback and influencing product priorities BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Experience in a customer-facing role at the intersection of business and technology PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Thrives in customer-facing roles Experience working at the intersection of business and technology and thriving in customer-facing roles Able to translate customer needs into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes Understand modern engineering orgs, the SDLC, developer workflows, and tool adoption Communicate comfortably with both developers and senior executives Analytical and operational, using data to prioritize and drive action Already a power user of Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot, or Grok APIs (or modern AI tools for knowledge work and coding) with strong opinions about what great looks like (big plus) ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Remote but must be willing to travel to customer onsites as needed COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,500 - $200,000.
